The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twelfth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S12|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== {{incomplete|section|Disc divisions}} Two Galactic Battles Collections were released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in 2011, containing the whole season between them. The DVDs do not include English closed captioning. ===Pokémon DP: Galactic Battles - Collection 1=== [[File:DP GB Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Collection 1]] Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on March 2, 2011 and in New Zealand on February 19, 2011. It contains three discs with 26 episodes across them combined and uses a {{wp|4:3}} {{wp|aspect ratio}}. ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]'' |} ==Season 12 disc set== [[File:DP GB Season 12.png|thumb|DigiPack cover art]] [[File:DP GB Season 12 Repack.png|thumb|Slimline cover art]] {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing DigiPack disc sets of each season in 2010. The Season 12 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Magna Pacific}} (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) in Australia on June 1, 2011 and in New Zealand on June 16, 2011. It contains six discs with 52 episodes across them combined and uses a {{wp|4:3}} {{wp|aspect ratio}}. Its catalogue number is DBX13643. Its discs are designed to resemble a [[Dusk Ball]]. The DigiPack disc set was re-released exclusive to JB Hi-Fi online [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/980903292007738 on July 14, 2016] and in JB Hi-Fi stores [https://www.facebook.com/BeyondHomeEntertainment/posts/1034172803347453 on September 21, 2016] to celebrate the [[Pokémon 20th Anniversary]]. The DVDs don't include English closed captioning. This disc set was re-released by Beyond Home Entertainment in a slimline case in Australia on April 2, 2014 with a different cover and the catalogue number BHE5396. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of a specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
